instruction: Login to Azure Container Registry from the CLI
output: az acr login --name myregistry

instruction: List all Azure Container Registries in a subscription
output: az acr list --output table

instruction: Build a container image in ACR from a Dockerfile
output: az acr build --registry myregistry --image myapp:1.0 .

instruction: Import an image from Docker Hub to ACR
output: az acr import --name myregistry --source docker.io/library/nginx:latest --image nginx:latest

instruction: List repositories in an Azure Container Registry
output: az acr repository list --name myregistry --output table

instruction: Show tags for a repository in ACR
output: az acr repository show-tags --name myregistry --repository myapp
az acr repository delete --name myregistry --repository myapp --tag 1.0 --yes
az acr show --name myregistry --query loginServer --output tsv

instruction: Enable the admin account on ACR
output: az acr update --name myregistry --admin-enabled true
az acr credential show --name myregistry

instruction: Add a Helm repository from an ACR
output: az acr helm repo add --name myregistry

instruction: Push a Helm chart to ACR
output: az acr helm push mychart-1.0.0.tgz --name myregistry
az acr helm list --name myregistry

instruction: Delete a Helm chart from ACR
output: az acr helm delete --name myregistry --repository mychart --version 1.0.0
az acr show-usage --name myregistry

instruction: Create a task in ACR that triggers on Git commits
output: az acr task create --registry myregistry --name mytask --image myapp:{{.Run.ID}} --context https://github.com/myuser/myapp.git --branch main --file Dockerfile
az acr task run --registry myregistry --name mytask
az acr task list --registry myregistry --output table
az acr task logs --registry myregistry --name mytask --run-id run1

instruction: Lock an image in ACR to prevent deletion
output: az acr repository update --name myregistry --repository myapp --delete-enabled false --write-enabled false
az acr run --cmd "acr purge --filter 'myapp:.*' --ago 30d" --registry myregistry /dev/null
curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
az login
az account set --subscription my-subscription-id
az acr webhook list --registry myregistry --output table
